title: ImportEdgeContribution
description: An import / use directive linking a module/file to an imported symbol or module. Pattern-C universal slot (§8bis Rule 2). Producers (Rule 1): `ScipJavaKS` and other per-language ScipKSs; `JoernKS`.

fromSymbol.description: SCIP symbol id of the source endpoint (must resolve to a Index.ScipSymbol (or other code-bearing slot) in this Bb).

toSymbol.description: SCIP symbol id of the target endpoint (must resolve to a Index.ScipSymbol (or other code-bearing slot) in this Bb).

path.description: Path of the file containing the import directive.
